text: 路透引述消息称，中国跨境快时尚巨头希音(SHEIN)已获联交所上市委员会批准进行IPO，并计划于本月27日发布可供公众查阅的上市文件，最快8月底上市。 知情人士透露，希音已开始安排与投资者的营销会议，目标估值约400亿-500亿美元(约3120亿-3920亿港元)，集资额料约20亿-30亿美元(约156亿-234亿港元)。此外，据中国证监会上周五通知显示，希音已获准发行不超过3.41亿股境外上市普通股，并在港交所上市。 希音此次IPO将成为香港近年最受关注的上市案例之一，也是对投资者对大型消费类企业发股的重大考验。
text_en: Reuters cited sources saying that Chinese cross-border fast-fashion giant SHEIN has received approval from the Hong Kong Stock Exchange listing committee for its IPO, plans to publish a publicly available listing document on the 27th of this month, and aims to list by the end of August at the earliest. Insiders revealed that SHEIN has begun arranging marketing meetings with investors, with a target valuation of approximately $40-50 billion and expected fundraising of about $2-3 billion. Additionally, according to a notice from the CSRC last Friday, SHEIN has been approved to issue no more than 341 million overseas-listed ordinary shares and list on the HKEX. This IPO will be one of the most anticipated listings in Hong Kong in recent years and a major test of investor appetite for large consumer-focused companies.
